title: Zhao Yun Kills Five Generals in One Morning; Three Commanderies Revolt
summary: Zhao Yun, refused a command on grounds of age, takes the vanguard anyway and kills five Wei officers in a single engagement — one of them a father, then his son, then his three brothers, in order, as they come at him one after another.
Three commanderies west of Chang'an go over to Shu without a fight. For a few weeks the northern expedition looks unstoppable.
history: Zhao Yun's last campaign is historical, and so is the revolt of the three commanderies. The five kills in a morning are the novel enjoying itself.

pins.note: Five officers in one morning, at over seventy.
Proposes the Ziwu valley raid, and is refused.
